Next: admissible same-claim evidence is materially incompatible and no existing governed resolution applies; never average or vote.
Next: no attributable evidence for the assessed claim.
Next: evidence verifies context but no directly transferable parameter conclusion.
Exact compatible canonical constraint or original fully reproducible same-purpose independent evidence, limitations known, no unresolved material conflict. Never approval.
Direct independent support with bounded disclosed transfer/reproduction limits, no material conflict; enough only for constrained proposal deliberation.
Independent partial support; essential assumptions or compatibility remain unresolved. Cannot select actual parameter.
